# Presentation dependencies

`reveal/` contains Reveal.js 5.1.0, its standard plugins, Prism, and the PPDS specific plugins and styles. These files were copied from the [source presentation's shared assets](https://kvistgaard.github.io/slides/common/) on 26 November 2026 so the integrated deck can be developed and tested locally. The diagrams in `assets/diagrams/` came from the same [source presentation](https://kvistgaard.github.io/slides/ppds/day-2026/).

Keep upstream attribution and licenses when updating these files. Live PPDS data and services remain at their original URLs and are not stored in this repository.
